mnemonic.meaning: 日 day + 付 attach: the day attached to something.
mnemonic.reading: "HI, ZUKE!" (ひづけ) Hi, Zuke, put the date on it.

examples.ja: 書類に今日の日付を書いてください。
examples.en: Please write today's date on the form.

items.note: The date written or printed. 日にち is a date or a number of days.

mnemonic.meaning: 亡 = dead: lose someone to death.
mnemonic.reading: "NAKUSU!" (なくす) Same sound as 無くす (to lose a thing).

examples.ja: 彼は事故で父を亡くした。
examples.en: He lost his father in an accident.

items.note: For people. Losing things is 無くす.

mnemonic.meaning: 同 same + 志 aim: someone with the same aim.
mnemonic.reading: "DOU, SHE!" (どうし) Same sound as 同士 (Level 3).

examples.ja: 同志を集めて会を作った。
examples.en: He gathered like-minded people and formed a group.

items.note: 同志 = shared ideals. 同士 = people of the same kind.

mnemonic.meaning: 説 has 言 (words): explaining with words.
mnemonic.reading: "TOKU!" (とく) Same sound as 解く (solve). You solve it by explaining.

examples.ja: 先生は勉強の大切さを説いた。
examples.en: The teacher explained the importance of study.

items.note: Formal. Often for teaching or persuading. 説明する is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 裂 has 衣 (cloth): cloth splitting. It tears by itself.
mnemonic.reading: "SAKERU!" (さける) Same sound as 避ける (avoid).

examples.ja: 強い風で旗が裂けた。
examples.en: The flag tore in the strong wind.

items.note: Intransitive partner of 裂く (Level 11). 口が裂けても言えない = I'd never say it.

mnemonic.meaning: 真 true + 理 logic: true logic.
mnemonic.reading: "SHIN, REE!" (しんり) Same sound as 心理 (psychology).

examples.ja: 彼は真理を求めて旅に出た。
examples.en: He set out on a journey in search of truth.

items.note: Philosophical truth. 真実 (しんじつ) is the facts of a matter.

mnemonic.meaning: 連 connect + 想 idea: connecting ideas.
mnemonic.reading: "REN, SOU!" (れんそう) Ren's so good at linking ideas.

examples.ja: 青い色から海を連想する。
examples.en: The colour blue makes me think of the sea.

items.note: AからBを連想する = A reminds you of B.

mnemonic.meaning: 進 advance + 歩 step: stepping forward.
mnemonic.reading: "SHIN, POH!" (しんぽ) Your shin takes a step forward.

examples.ja: 科学技術は大きく進歩した。
examples.en: Science and technology have made great progress.

items.note: Improvement in skill or society. 進化 (しんか) = evolution.

mnemonic.meaning: 設 set up + 計 plan: planning how to set it up.
mnemonic.reading: "SEK, KAY!" (せっけい) Set the plans, okay?

examples.ja: この家は有名な建築家が設計した。
examples.en: A famous architect designed this house.

items.note: Design in engineering and architecture. 人生設計 = life plan. デザイン is looks and style.

mnemonic.meaning: 用 use + 心 mind: using your mind. Being careful.
mnemonic.reading: "YOU, JIN!" (ようじん) You and gin: be careful.

examples.ja: 火の用心。
examples.en: Beware of fire.

items.note: 用心深い = cautious. 火の用心 is a traditional fire-safety call.

mnemonic.meaning: SHIBASHIBA: a shiba dog that barks "shiba, shiba" often.

examples.ja: 彼はしばしば会議に遅れる。
examples.en: He's often late for meetings.

items.note: Formal and written. よく / たびたび are close.

mnemonic.meaning: 発 develop + 達 reach: developing until it reaches a stage.
mnemonic.reading: "HATTA, TSU!" (はったつ) Hats grow and develop.

examples.ja: 子供の言葉の発達は早い。
examples.en: Children's language develops quickly.

items.note: Natural growth: 体の発達, 技術の発達. 発展 is growth of cities and economies.

mnemonic.meaning: 分 part + 野 field: a part of the field.
mnemonic.reading: "BUN, YA!" (ぶんや) A bun of a field, yeah.

examples.ja: 彼は医学の分野で有名だ。
examples.en: He's famous in the field of medicine.

items.note: Field of study or work. 専門分野 = your speciality.

mnemonic.meaning: 首 head + 都 city: the head city.
mnemonic.reading: "SHOE, TOE!" (しゅと) The capital's shoes are tight on your toes.

examples.ja: 日本の首都は東京だ。
examples.en: The capital of Japan is Tokyo.

items.note: 首都圏 = the greater Tokyo area.

mnemonic.meaning: 団 group + 体 body: a group body.
mnemonic.reading: "DAN, TIE!" (だんたい) Dan ties the group together.

examples.ja: 団体で旅行すると安くなる。
examples.en: It's cheaper if you travel as a group.

items.note: 団体旅行 = group tour. 団体戦 = team match.

mnemonic.meaning: 出 go out + 場 place: going out onto the field.
mnemonic.reading: "SHUTSU, JOU!" (しゅつじょう) Shoots and joins the match. Note: 出 is しゅつ here.

examples.ja: 彼はオリンピックに出場した。
examples.en: He competed in the Olympics.

items.note: Competing in an event or tournament. 出席 (しゅっせき) is attending a class or meeting.

mnemonic.meaning: 務 has 力 (power): putting your power into a task.
mnemonic.reading: "TSUTOME!" (つとめ) From 務める (to serve).

examples.ja: 子供を守るのは親の務めだ。
examples.en: It's a parent's duty to protect their children.

items.note: Duty. 勤め (same reading) = employment, a job.

mnemonic.meaning: 成 become + 人 person: become a full person.
mnemonic.reading: "SAY, JIN!" (せいじん) Say "gin!" when you're an adult.

examples.ja: 日本では十八歳で成人になる。
examples.en: In Japan you become an adult at 18.

items.note: 成人式 = coming-of-age ceremony. 大人 is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 交 exchange + 際 occasion: occasions of exchange.
mnemonic.reading: "KOU, SIGH!" (こうさい) You sigh while dating.

examples.ja: 二人は一年前から交際している。
examples.en: The two have been seeing each other for a year.

items.note: Formal. 付き合う (WaniKani) is everyday. Also social relations: 交際費 (entertainment expenses).

mnemonic.meaning: 絵 picture + 画 picture: a picture.
mnemonic.reading: "KAI, GA!" (かいが) Kai paints a picture.

examples.ja: 美術館で有名な絵画を見た。
examples.en: I saw famous paintings at the art museum.

items.note: Formal, art-world word. 絵 is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 包 = something wrapped up.
mnemonic.reading: "TSUTSUMI!" (つつみ) From 包む (to wrap).

examples.ja: 母から大きな包みが届いた。
examples.en: A big parcel arrived from my mother.

items.note: 包み紙 = wrapping paper.

items.pos: noun, する verb, な adjective

mnemonic.meaning: ITAZURA: "It as zoo-ra!" The monkeys at the zoo play pranks.

examples.ja: 子供のいたずらで窓が割れた。
examples.en: The window got broken by a child's mischief.

items.note: Kanji: 悪戯. いたずら電話 = prank call.

mnemonic.meaning: 一人 one person, repeated: one person, one person.
mnemonic.reading: "HITORI, HITORI!" (ひとりひとり) One by one.

examples.ja: 先生は生徒一人一人に声をかけた。
examples.en: The teacher spoke to each student.

items.note: Emphasises each individual.

mnemonic.meaning: 覚 has 見 (see): your eyes see again. Waking up.
mnemonic.reading: "SAMERU!" (さめる) Same sound as 冷める (Level 8).

examples.ja: 朝早く目が覚めた。
examples.en: I woke up early in the morning.

items.note: 目が覚める = to wake up. Transitive: 覚ます.

mnemonic.meaning: 深 deep: it becomes deeper.
mnemonic.reading: "FUKA, MARU!" (ふかまる) The deep circle grows.

examples.ja: 秋が深まってきた。
examples.en: Autumn has deepened.

items.note: Intransitive partner of 深める (Level 11).

mnemonic.meaning: 敬 respect + 意 mind: a respectful mind.
mnemonic.reading: "KAY, EE!" (けいい) Same sound as 経緯 (Level 10).

examples.ja: 先輩に敬意を払う。
examples.en: I show respect to my seniors.

items.note: 敬意を払う / 表す = to pay respect. 敬語 = honorific language.

mnemonic.meaning: 善 has 羊 (sheep) on top: a gentle sheep, a symbol of goodness.
mnemonic.reading: "ZEN!" (ぜん) Zen: being good.

examples.ja: 善と悪の区別。
examples.en: Telling good from evil.

items.note: Formal. 善は急げ = do good things quickly (strike while the iron is hot).

mnemonic.meaning: 演 perform + 説 explain: performing an explanation.
mnemonic.reading: "EN, ZETSU!" (えんぜつ) Note: 説 becomes ぜつ here.

examples.ja: 首相が国民に向けて演説した。
examples.en: The prime minister gave a speech to the nation.

items.note: A public speech, often political. スピーチ is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 先 ahead + 行 go: go ahead.
mnemonic.reading: "SEN, KOU!" (せんこう) A thousand go ahead.

examples.ja: チケットの先行販売が始まった。
examples.en: The advance ticket sale has started.

items.note: 先行き = the outlook ahead.

mnemonic.meaning: 近 near + 頃 time: recent times.
mnemonic.reading: "CHIKA, GORO!" (ちかごろ) Close (近い) to now.

examples.ja: 近頃、物価が高くなった。
examples.en: Prices have gone up recently.

items.note: Slightly old-fashioned. 最近 is everyday.
